tasks.build: denext task tokens && denext export . && denext deno run --allow-read=. --allow-write=out scripts/postexport.ts
tasks.build:test: denext task tokens && PAROLNET_BUILD=test denext export . && denext deno run --allow-read=. --allow-write=out,out-test scripts/postexport.ts --test
tasks.test: denext test tests/unit && denext task test:engine
tasks.e2e: cd tests/e2e && npm ci && npx playwright test --project=chromium --project=firefox --project=webkit
tasks.e2e:flows: cd tests/e2e && npm ci && npx playwright test --project=flows-chromium --project=flows-firefox --project=flows-webkit
tasks.engine:e2e: cd tests/engine/e2e && npm ci && node run.mjs
tasks.check: denext check src scripts tests/unit tests/engine/*.ts tests/engine/harness tests/engine/e2e/build.ts tests/engine/e2e/harness denext.config.ts
